standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Oh G'day! Sorry, didn't see you there!

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: That's okay. What seems to be the problem?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Oh, well I wanted to catch some minnows so I could use 'em as bait, but the little blighters are just too quick! I managed to get 'em all rounded up over on my fishing platform, but I still can't catch 'em!
Then, to make things worse, any time I do finally catch some, those bloody flying fish jump out at me and gobble up me minnows!
What I need is someone who can catch 'em for me!

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Well, maybe I could help out?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Well I don't know. I don't want to be letting just anyone onto me fishing platform! But I guess if you could show me that you are a worthy fisher than that would be okay. I can even give you shark in exchange
for the minnows you catch, 'cos them I can catch no problem!

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: Sounds fair. What can I do to show that I am worthy?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.npc: Well you should be very experienced in the art of fishing, own the proper attire, and be recognised by your peers as a great fisherman.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: You must have level 82 Fishing, be wearing the complete Angler's outfit and have completed Fishing Contest in order to suitably impress Kylie.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.player: So, how about letting me out onto your fishing platform?

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: If the player meets all the requirements:

steps.npc: Ripper! You certainly seem to be the real deal, so sure, go ahead and take the boat over there. Oh, and don't worry about wearing that angling gear if yous don't want to, I just wanted to see that you took fishing
serious enough to have the right attire.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: If the player doesn't have 82 Fishing:

steps.npc: Sorry, but I just don't think you are experienced enough.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: If the player hasn't completed the Fishing Contest:

steps.npc: Sorry, but I just don't think you are renowned enough as a [fisherman/fisherwoman].

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: If the player isn't wearing the Angler's outfit:

steps.npc: Sorry, but I just don't think you are wearin' suitable fishing gear.

standard-dialogue-first-time-talking-to-.text: You must have level 82 Fishing, be wearing the complete Angler's outfit and have completed Fishing Contest in order to suitably impress Kylie.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-kylie-minno.player: So, how about letting me out onto your fishing platform?

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-board-th.npc: G'day, only the best fishers are allowed onto the fishing platform. You need a fishing level of 82.
I don't think I have given you access to my fishing platform. Come and speak to me if you would like to get access.

after-gaining-access-talking-to-kylie.npc: Have you got any minnows for trade? I have plenty of nice, fresh sharks waiting for ya!

steps.text: With open inventory space and at least 40 minnows:

steps.npc: I can give you a shark for every 40 minnows that you give me. How many sharks would you like?
You'll be needing at least 40 minnows to trade for a shark! Come back and see me when you have some more!
I can't trade you any sharks while you don't have any space for them!

after-gaining-access-trade-option-withou.npc: You'll be needing at least 40 minnows to trade for a shark! Come back and see me when you have some more!
